scene black
I spread all ten key pieces I’ve collected on the ground and use the tiny attachments at the end of each one to put them back together.
lines.zh: 我把收集到的十块钥匙碎片全摊在地上，用每块末端的小卡榫把它们重新拼了起来。

lines.en: I don’t know what asshole broke such a pretty key into so many pieces, but I guess it doesn’t matter anymore since I was able to restore it to its former glory.
lines.zh: 我不知道是哪个混蛋把这么漂亮的钥匙碎成了这么多块，不过既然我已经让它恢复了往日的光彩，我想这也不重要了。

lines.en: I take the key and place it in my mouth to make sure that all of the parts taste right before using it on the door.
lines.zh: 我把钥匙放进嘴里尝了尝，确认每一部分的味道都对，然后才拿它去开门。

lines.en: It tastes like what you would probably imagine a key tastes like, so I assume everything is correct and make my way to the handle.
lines.zh: 味道大概和你想象中钥匙该有的味道一样，所以我断定一切无误，走向门把手。

lines.en: I place the key inside and wiggle it around until the door cums.
lines.zh: 我把钥匙插进去，来回拧动，直到门射了。

lines.en: Sorry, I mean “opens.”
lines.zh: 抱歉，我是说「开了」。

lines.en: But unlocking a door with a key is kind of like door sex and the unlocking part is kind of like an orgasm.
lines.zh: 不过拿钥匙开锁跟跟门做爱差不多，开锁那个瞬间就有点像高潮。

lines.en: At least that’s what I’ve always thought.
lines.zh: 至少我一直都是这么想的。

lines.en: Anyway, I probably shouldn’t stay in here anymore for it is clearly and negatively affecting my mental health.
lines.zh: 总之，我大概不该再待在这里了，这显然正在对我的精神健康造成负面影响。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth1
I walk into my completely normal and not at all lopsided living room. But before exiting my home and going on another journey, I peer outside of the window.
lines.zh: 我走进我那完全正常、一点都不歪斜的客厅。但在出门踏上另一段旅程之前，我往窗外瞥了一眼。

lines.en: I see a melting world, packed to the brim with collapsing buildings and more colors than you could fit into ten rainbows if all of them had different colors or something.
lines.zh: 我看到一个正在融化的世界，塞满了坍塌的建筑，颜色多到十条彩虹都装不下——如果每条彩虹颜色都不一样的那种。

lines.en: My ability to make metaphors always suffers during times like this, but I can guarantee you that some crazy shit is going down right now.
lines.zh: 这种时候我的比喻能力总是会掉线，但我可以保证，现在外面正在发生一些很疯狂的事。

lines.en: I breathe onto the window and draw my initials on the glass.
lines.zh: 我朝窗户哈了口气，在玻璃上写下自己名字的首字母。

lines.en: I forget them the moment I turn away.
lines.zh: 我一转身就忘了它们。

lines.en: I’ll remember again when the time is right.
lines.zh: 等时机到了，我会再想起来的。

lines.en: scene black
scene endofthefourth2
: CONGRATULATIONS!
lines.zh: : 恭喜你！

lines.en: : What’s this?!
lines.zh: : 这是什么？！

lines.en: scene endofthefourth3
: A CELEBRATION JUST FOR YOU!
lines.zh: : 一场专属于你的庆祝！

lines.en: : YOU’VE SURVIVED THE WINTER! EVERYONE IS VERY IMPRESSED!
lines.zh: : 你熬过了冬天！大家都非常佩服！

lines.en: : Oh, you guys! Have you been waiting out here this whole time?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你们这些人！你们一直在外面等着吗？

lines.en: : WHERE ELSE WOULD WE GO RIGHT NOW? YOU SAW THE WORLD FROM THE WINDOWS, DID YOU NOT?
lines.zh: : 这个时候我们还能去哪儿？你从窗户里看见那个世界了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Okay, okay. That’s enough yelling.
lines.zh: : 好啦好啦。别再喊了。

lines.en: : Yeah, my throat was starting to hurt.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我嗓子都开始疼了。

lines.en: : I’m the pink one!
lines.zh: : 我是粉色的那个！

lines.en: : In all seriousness, congratulations. And, in even more seriousness, yes. We’ve been waiting out here the entire time. But do you know {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 说正经的，恭喜你。再说更正经的，没错，我们一直在外面等。但你知道{i}为什么{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Because it’s my birth-
lines.zh: : 因为今天是我的生-

lines.en: : Because we knew you could do it!
lines.zh: : 因为我们知道你做得到！

lines.en: : We’ve never had more faith in you succeeding before, Sensei! We all knew you were going to pull through this time!
lines.zh: : 我们从来没有像现在这样相信你会成功，Sensei！我们都知道这次你一定能挺过来！

lines.en: : I had my doubts, but I {i}am{/i} glad to see you did it.
lines.zh: : 我本来是有点怀疑的，但我{i}确实{/i}很高兴看到你做到了。

lines.en: : And everybody else???
lines.zh: : 那其他所有人呢？？？

lines.en: : Who is everyone else?
lines.zh: : 其他所有人是谁？

lines.en: scene endofthefourth4
: The hundreds of other mysterious figures lining both the streets and the skies.
lines.zh: : 就是挤满街道和天空的那几百个神秘人影。

lines.en: : Oooooooh, them.
: Yeah, they’ve been waiting too.
lines.zh: : 对，他们也在等。

lines.en: : YOU DID IT!
lines.zh: : 你做到了！

lines.en: I did it!
lines.zh: 我做到了！

lines.en: : You did it!
lines.zh: : 你做到了！

lines.en: scene endofthefourth5
: Ami! You’re alive!
lines.zh: : Ami！你还活着！

lines.en: : Of course I’m alive! What’s a trip to school in the middle of the night without your doting and mildly obsessive [niece]?
lines.zh: : 我当然活着！大半夜跑去学校，要是没有你那个宠你又有点痴迷的[niece]陪着，那还叫什么事儿？

lines.en: : Did you see me solve the puzzle? I was very smart and only needed a little bit of help.
lines.zh: : 你看到我解出那道谜题了吗？我可聪明了，只需要别人帮一点点忙。

lines.en: : I did! You {i}really{/i} like rice!
lines.zh: : 我看到了！你{i}真的{/i}很喜欢米饭！

lines.en: : We should hit the town to celebrate.
lines.zh: : 我们该进城好好庆祝一下。

lines.en: : I was going to suggest the same exact thing! I was just kinda hoping we could maybe do it a few times first.
lines.zh: : 我正想提一模一样的建议呢！我只是有点希望我们能先做几次。

lines.en: : But with your body all twisted, I wouldn’t even know where to put it.
lines.zh: : 可你身上缠着这根绳子，我都不知道该把它放在哪儿。

lines.en: : Anywhere you want! I’m up for anything!
lines.zh: : 你想放哪儿都行！我什么都愿意！

lines.en: : Right here? Really?
lines.zh: : 就在这儿？真的？

lines.en: : Shut up, Green! We all know you would do the same!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，绿色！谁都知道你也会这么干的！

lines.en: : So would-
lines.zh: : 我也会-

lines.en: : [amimaster], I can’t believe I’m saying this, but it would probably be for the best if we {i}didn’t{/i} do it right now.
lines.zh: : [amimaster]，我真不敢相信自己会说出这种话，但我们现在{i}不{/i}做，恐怕才是最好的选择。

lines.en: : We’re still ahead of schedule, though! So we’ll have plenty of time to do it once we get to the school.
lines.zh: : 不过我们还比预定时间早呢！所以等到了学校，我们有大把时间可以做。

lines.en: : Remember to look both ways when crossing the street! You never know when someone might let go of the wheel!
lines.zh: : 过马路记得左右看！你永远不知道什么时候会有人松开方向盘！

lines.en: : I am ready for school! But there is just one problem.
lines.zh: : 我准备好去学校了！但有个问题。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, [mayamaster]?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，[mayamaster]？

lines.en: : How am I supposed to walk with this huge string tied around my penis???
lines.zh: : 我下面系着这么大一根绳子，要怎么走路啊？？？

lines.en: I point to the string in case Ami isn’t able to see it. Her eyes have always been bad.
lines.zh: 我指了指那根绳子，免得 Ami 看不见。她眼神一直不好。

lines.en: : Beats me! It hasn’t stopped you so far.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢！反正到现在也没碍着你。

lines.en: : Now shut up and move through the choir of angels, Sensei! And if any of them don’t want to step aside for you, feel free to push them over.
lines.zh: : 那就闭嘴，从这群天使中间穿过去，Sensei！要是有谁不肯给你让路，尽管把他们推开。

lines.en: : We might get in trouble for it later, but it’s the right thing to do in the moment.
lines.zh: : 事后可能会惹上麻烦，但当下这么做才是对的。

lines.en: : Can I at least say goodbye to all of my new friends, first?
lines.zh: : 我至少能先跟我这些新朋友道个别吧？

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: : Darn it!
lines.zh: : 可恶！

lines.zh: : 谢谢 Sensei！那么，让我们看看我们-哦！

lines.en: : This one’s probably still fresh in everyone’s memories!
lines.zh: : 这个大家应该还记忆犹新吧！

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} it will heighten the impact of the current scene and the way it ultimately has to end.
lines.zh: : {i}而且{/i}它能强化当前这一幕的冲击力，以及它最终必须结束的方式。

lines.en: : That was such a cute little date you and Maya had. I really wish I could have been there for it.
lines.zh: : 你和 Maya 那次约会真可爱。我真希望自己当时也在场。

lines.en: : How come you never invite me anywhere anymore?
lines.zh: : 你怎么最近都不邀请我了？

lines.en: : What are you talking about? We went on a cool bus ride just yesterday.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我们昨天才一起坐了很酷的巴士。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} went on a bus ride. All {i}I{/i} did was dream. That’s totally different, Sensei.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}坐了巴士。{i}我{/i}全程都在做梦。这完全不一样，Sensei。

lines.en: : My bad. It seems so long ago at this point.
lines.zh: : 我的错。现在想来好像是很久以前的事了。

lines.en: : Hey, would you like me more if there was a mini Maya with an engorged head that followed me around everywhere?
lines.zh: : 嘿，要是有一个脑袋胀大的迷你 Maya 天天跟在我身后，你会更喜欢我吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t like you any {i}less!{/i} But where would you obtain such a thing on such short notice?
lines.zh: : 我不会{i}更不{/i}喜欢你！但你上哪儿去临时弄这么个东西？

lines.en: : Oh, I already have one. I’ve just been keeping her in my pocket since I was afraid you’d mistake her for an onahole and I am perpetually in need of your semen.
lines.zh: : 哦，我已经有一个了。只是一直把她揣在口袋里，因为我怕你把她误当成飞机杯，而我永远都需要你的精液。

lines.en: : Maya 2, come! Just not literally!
lines.zh: : Maya 2，过来！不是字面意义上的过来！

: There she is! Are you in love with me yet???
lines.zh: : 她来啦！你爱上我了吗？？？

lines.zh: : 哇。她长得跟真的 Maya 一模一样，就是脑袋胀大，还会飘。

lines.zh: : 她会说话吗？

lines.zh: : 算是吧。她只会说这一句。

lines.en: : It’s a weird default setting, but I haven’t really had the time to see if she can do anything else since I’ve been so busy trying to drown her in the bathtub.
lines.zh: : 这个默认设定挺怪的，不过我一直忙着把她按在浴缸里淹死，也没空看看她还能干点什么。

lines.en: : You should treat your toys better, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你应该对自己的玩具好一点，Ami。

lines.en: : You should treat {i}me{/i} better.
lines.zh: : 你应该对{i}我{/i}好一点。

lines.en: : I overheard you talking to Maya about how getting pregnant gives people a chance to make it up to the roof, and I always disappear before I reach the top step! It’s not fair!
lines.zh: : 我偷听到你跟 Maya 说，怀孕能让人有机会冲上屋顶，可我每次都在踏到最上面那级台阶之前就消失了！这不公平！

lines.en: : So yeah, if you would just keep trying to breed me, I wouldn’t have to get all squiggly and milk you dry while you’re sleeping anymore.
lines.zh: : 所以啊，只要你继续努力让我怀孕，我就不用再趁你睡着的时候扭来扭去把你榨干了。

lines.en: : I’m going to need a new lock for my door.
lines.zh: : 我得给我的门换把新锁了。

lines.en: : That’s rude! If you didn’t like it, you wouldn’t cum so much!
lines.zh: : 太过分了！你要是不喜欢，怎么会射那么多！

lines.en: : No, like I literally need a new lock for my door. I put my fancy puzzle key inside of it too many times on the way out today and I think it might have broken.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是真的需要一把新锁。今天出门的时候我把那把高级谜题钥匙插进去太多次，我觉得可能插坏了。

lines.en: : Oh.
: I guess we can pick one up on the way to school then.
lines.zh: : 那我们可以在去学校的路上顺一把。

lines.en: : Yay! Best [niece] ever!
lines.zh: : 耶！世界上最棒的[niece]！

Ami and I make it to the hardware store and search around for locks, but keep getting blocked by stock image watermarks that the staff forgot to clean up.
lines.zh: 我和 Ami 到了五金店四处找锁，却一直被店员忘了清理的图库水印挡住视线。

lines.en: : What kind of lock do you think would work best for a bedroom door?
lines.zh: : 你觉得卧室门用哪种锁最好？

lines.en: There are no associates around so I have to ask Ami, who may or may not know anything about hardware.
lines.zh: 周围一个店员都没有，我只能问 Ami，而她可能对五金一无所知。

lines.en: : Hmm...maybe one of those touch pad type ones? The ones where it needs your fingerprint.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许那种触屏式的？就是要用指纹的那种。

lines.en: : But what if someone chops off my finger and uses it to make it into my room? There are things I need to protect in there.
lines.zh: : 可要是有人把我的手指砍下来，用它进我房间怎么办？我房间里有些东西需要保护。

lines.en: : Like the door to the attic where all of my mom’s things are?
lines.zh: : 比如通往阁楼、放着我妈所有遗物的那扇门？

lines.en: : There are things I need to protect in there.
lines.zh: : 我房间里有些东西需要保护。

lines.en: : Like the secret folder of nude photos you have of Maya?
lines.zh: : 比如你藏着 Maya 裸照的那个秘密文件夹？

lines.en: : There are-
lines.zh: : 有些-

lines.en: : How old is she in those, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那些照片里她多大，Sensei？

lines.en: : There-
lines.zh: : 有些-

lines.en: : Stuck on loop? Right now? What are you, Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 卡带了？就现在？你当自己是 Kumon-mi 吗？

lines.en: The staff of the hardware store laughs and I get a little embarrassed.
lines.zh: 五金店的店员笑了起来，我有点不好意思。

lines.en: I pick the first lock (As in {i}select{/i}. Not like, lockpick) I can find and quickly ring myself up at the self-checkout register.
lines.zh: 我随手挑了（是「{i}挑选{/i}」，不是「撬开」）找到的第一把锁，迅速在自助收银台给自己结了账。

lines.en: I forget to grab a bag and also forget to grab the lock and then run out of the store.
lines.zh: 我忘了拿袋子，也忘了拿锁，然后就跑出了店。

The Maya doll is fast, so it is able to keep up with me and tie a second lasso around my penis that she squeezes really tight, giving Ami the time to catch up.
lines.zh: Maya 娃娃速度很快，所以她追上了我，在我下面又套上第二根套索，还勒得特别紧，给 Ami 争取到追上来的时间。

lines.en: I curse the day I bought her that special outfit.
lines.zh: 我诅咒买那套特殊服装给她的那一天。

show amihappyyay
show mayadoll
: Jeez. I forgot how good you are when it comes to running away from stuff.
lines.zh: : 天哪。我都忘了你逃跑有多在行。

lines.en: : Cha cha cha.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。

lines.en: : You tell him, Maya 2.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Maya 2。

lines.en: : Why did we come here again?
lines.zh: : 我们干嘛又来这儿了？

lines.en: : I feel like there’s a thing I’m supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得有件该做的事。

lines.en: : You probably haven’t remembered yet because we're so ahead of schedule. We’ve still got plenty of time left until {i}she{/i} gets here.
lines.zh: : 你大概还没想起来，因为我们进度超前太多了。离{i}她{/i}到这儿还有的是时间。

lines.en: Ami stares at-
lines.zh: Ami 盯着-

lines.zh: Ami 盯着 Maya 2，她那些涂鸦拧成一对巨大的怒眉，扎进她的头皮、扎出血来——但没有昨天在咖啡厅里她的手{s}s{/s}流得多。

lines.en: I can see that they’ve healed all but entirely now.
lines.zh: 我看得出来，那些伤口现在几乎完全愈合了。

lines.en: : So...what do you want to do since we have so much time to kill?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然还有大把时间要打发，你想做点什么？

lines.en: : Play with the Maya doll? She is annoyingly durable.
lines.zh: : 玩 Maya 娃娃？她结实得烦人。

lines.en: : Cha cha cha.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。

lines.zh: : 我饿了。

lines.zh: : 还饿？吃了那么多米饭之后？

lines.zh: : 我想要圆圆的、外面裹着一层纯白外衣的东西。

lines.en: : Oh! Well, I know just the place to go, then!
lines.zh: : 哦！那我正好知道该去哪儿！

lines.en: : Follow me, guys!
lines.zh: : 跟我来，各位！

lines.en: : It is egg time!
lines.zh: : 是鸡蛋时间！

lines.en: : Cha cha cha.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。

lines.zh: Ami 和 Maya 2 飘过走廊，而我比以往任何时候都更愤怒——我又得用我那双蠢腿了。

lines.en: : Yo you better be fucking kidding me right now.
lines.zh: : 喂，你他妈在跟我开玩笑吧。

lines.zh: : 抱歉，左腿。我忘了你是有知觉的。

lines.zh: : 你他妈当然忘了。整天踩着我不说，还他妈理直气壮的。你他妈脸皮真厚。

lines.zh: : Sensei！别跟你的腿说话了，快过来！这里有圆圆的食物！

: Coming, Ami!
lines.zh: : 来了，Ami！

lines.en: My leg shuts up when I pinch him, but I get a tiny bruise as a result.
lines.zh: 我掐了一下他，我的腿就闭嘴了，但代价是留下了一小块淤青。

lines.en: I ignore the slow transition of the color of my skin as the ruptured blood vessels underneath it begin to leak.
lines.zh: 我无视皮下破裂的血管开始渗血后，皮肤颜色那缓慢的变化。

lines.en: scene p1
scene p2
scene p3
scene p4
scene endofthefourth7
And I take my place in a room full of friends.
lines.zh: 然后我在一屋子朋友中间坐下了。

lines.en: : Cha cha cha.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。

lines.en: Our plates cover themselves in the purest of all foods, some even pipping before we have the chance to dig in.
lines.zh: 我们的盘子里盛满了所有食物中最纯粹的那一种，有些甚至还没等我们下手，就自己啄开了壳。

lines.en: The cafeteria comes alive with laughter and discussion, teleporting me back in time to when everything was simpler.
lines.zh: 食堂里充满了笑声和交谈，把我瞬间传送回了那个一切都很简单的年代。

lines.en: Before cursed birds and fireworks.
lines.zh: 在被诅咒的鸟和烟花之前。

lines.en: Before watermelons and violin.
lines.zh: 在西瓜和小提琴之前。

lines.en: Before the world began to melt into a puddle of refuse that I would scoop up with my hands and coat myself in.
lines.zh: 在世界开始融化成一滩垃圾、而我会用手把它捧起来涂满全身之前。

lines.en: If I had never seen it, this would not have happened.
lines.zh: 如果我从未见过它，这一切就不会发生。

lines.en: If I had never heard it, this could have been avoided.
lines.zh: 如果我从未听过它，这一切本可以避免。

lines.en: But I did.
lines.zh: 但我看见了。

lines.en: And so here we are.
lines.zh: 所以我们才走到了这一步。

lines.en: If only I was stronger.
lines.zh: 要是我更坚强一点就好了。

lines.en: If only she was here.
lines.zh: 要是她在这儿就好了。

lines.en: : Wow! The lunch room is really packed today!
lines.zh: : 哇！今天食堂人真多啊！

lines.en: : Everyone must have known you were coming, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 大家一定是知道你要来，Sensei！

lines.en: : But it was like that back at the house as well.
lines.zh: : 不过刚才在房子那边也是这样。

lines.en: : If you keep this up, you might have a {i}second{/i} harem comprised of more than just cute, innocent schoolgirls like me!
lines.zh: : 你再这么下去，说不定会拥有{i}第二个{/i}后宫，而且成员还不限于我这种可爱无辜的女学生！

lines.en: : Cha cha cha.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。

lines.en: : Yes I am, Maya 2. Shut up.
lines.zh: : 对，我就是，Maya 2。闭嘴。

lines.en: : Sensei, what’s wrong? You’ve barely touched your eggs.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你怎么了？你的鸡蛋都没怎么动。

lines.en: : There’s a little bird trying to escape from one of them. I can see its beak.
lines.zh: : 有个小鸟想从其中一个蛋里逃出来。我能看见它的喙。

lines.en: : So what? That just means there’s like, more protein or something.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？那只能说明蛋白质更多之类的吧。

lines.en: : Cha cha cha.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。

lines.en: : Even Maya 2 agrees and we {i}never{/i} see eye to eye.
lines.zh: : 连 Maya 2 都同意，而我们{i}从来{/i}没有意见一致过。

lines.en: : It probably doesn’t really help that her eyes are literally empty, but you know what I’m saying, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 她的眼睛本来就是空的，这可能确实没什么说服力，但你懂我的意思，对吧？

lines.en: I lift up the egg in my hand and the chirping of the small creature becomes audible, even with all of the noise in this room.
lines.zh: 我举起手里的鸡蛋，小家伙的啾啾声变得清晰可闻，哪怕这屋里吵得不行。

lines.en: The laughter and the conversations grow louder as if to distract me from what is in front of me, but-
lines.zh: 笑声和对话变得更响，像是要把我的注意力从我面前的东西上引开，但是-

lines.en: scene endofthefourth7
: Yum! Egg!
lines.zh: : 好吃！鸡蛋！

lines.en: I bite down on the egg. It feels a little like glass.
lines.zh: 我咬下那颗蛋。感觉有点像在咬玻璃。

lines.en: It leaves a sour taste in my mouth and something gets stuck in my throat.
lines.zh: 嘴里留下一股酸味，还有什么东西卡在嗓子里。

lines.en: After picking the shards of FOOD out of my teeth, I flick them at the table behind me and direct my full attention to Ami Arakawa, my loving [niece], and her best friend, Maya 2.
lines.zh: 把卡在牙缝里的食物碎片剔出来之后，我把它们弹向身后那张桌子，然后把全部注意力转向 Ami Arakawa，我亲爱的[niece]，以及她最好的朋友 Maya 2。

lines.en: : I wrote you another poem, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我又给你写了一首诗，Sensei……

lines.en: : And I’m really nervous about reading it to you...
lines.zh: : 我真的好紧张，不敢读给你听……

lines.en: : But if you could find it in your heart to listen to me for a second, I-
lines.zh: : 但如果你能发发善心，听我说一小会儿，我-

lines.en: scene endofthefourth8
: DON’T INTERRUPT ME WHEN I AM TRYING TO TAAAAAAAAAAALK!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 我正要说话的时候别打断我！！！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: : Cha cha cha.
lines.zh: : 恰恰恰。

lines.en: The sound of the school’s PA system turns on immediately after the bell, but no one seems to be paying any attention but me.
lines.zh: 铃声刚过，学校的广播就响了起来，但除了我，似乎没有人在听。

lines.en: Who would have known that all my friends are such terrible students?
lines.zh: 谁能想到我这些朋友全都是这么糟糕的学生？

lines.en: : DO NOT LISTEN TO THE ANNOUNCEMENT, SENSEI!
lines.zh: : 别听广播，Sensei！

lines.en: : LISTEN TO MY POEM!
lines.zh: : 听我的诗！

lines.en: : I MADE IT JUST FOR YOU!
lines.zh: : 这可是我专门为你写的！

lines.en: : Um...hello?
: Is this thing- yeah. Okay. It’s on. Uhh...
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿-好了，行了。开着呢。呃……

lines.en: : SENSEI! PAY ATTENTION TO ME!
lines.zh: : SENSEI！看我这边！

lines.en: : Ayane?...
lines.zh: : Ayane？……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Sensei, if you’re here...please come to the staff room.
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果你在的话……请来一趟教员室。

lines.en: : Everyone else is gone and...my phone isn’t working and...
lines.zh: : 其他人都不见了，而且……我的手机打不通，还有……

lines.en: : I’m really scared...
lines.zh: : 我好害怕……

lines.en: : I’m...{i}really{/i} scared...
lines.zh: : 我……{i}真的{/i}好害怕……

lines.en: : THE POEM GOES LIKE THIS.
lines.zh: : 这首诗是这样的。

lines.en: : A ROOM FULL OF SUN-
lines.zh: : 满满一屋子的阳光-

lines.en: : I...think I need to go, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我……想我得走了，Ami。

lines.en: : YOU DON’T NEED TO DO ANYTHING EXCEPT LISTEN TO MY POEM!
lines.zh: : 你什么都不用做，只要听我的诗就好！

lines.en: : SHE GETS ATTENTION WHENEVER SHE WANTS. I GET NOTHING.
lines.zh: : 她什么时候都能得到关注。我什么都得不到。

lines.en: : I GET NOTHING, SENSEI! STAY HERE AND LISTEN TO MY POEM!
lines.zh: : 我什么都得不到，Sensei！留在这儿听我的诗！

lines.en: : SENSEI!!!
lines.zh: : SENSEI！！！

lines.en: : Cha cha-
lines.zh: : 恰恰-

lines.en: scene black
: YOU WORTHLESS FUCKING DOLL!
lines.zh: : 你这没用的臭娃娃！

lines.en: : YOU WERE SUPPOSED TO MAKE HIM LOVE ME MORE!
lines.zh: : 你本来应该让他更爱我的！

lines.en: : NOW I HAVE TO WAIT EVEN LONGER!
lines.zh: : 现在我得等更久了！

lines.en: : LOOK WHAT YOU HAVE DONE!
lines.zh: : 看看你干的好事！

lines.en: Ami begins to beat on the secondary version of Maya while the main one lingers somewhere on the roof of the school.
lines.zh: Ami 开始殴打这个二号 Maya，而正牌的那个还徘徊在学校屋顶的某个地方。

lines.en: I doubt there will be another picnic on account of my arrival no longer being much cause for celebration...but I need to go regardless.
lines.zh: 我估计不会再有野餐了，因为我的到来已经算不上什么值得庆祝的事……但无论如何我得走。

lines.en: Not before stopping at the staff room, though.
lines.zh: 不过得先去一趟教员室。

lines.en: I have no idea how Ayane managed to make it here {i}again{/i}, but I know that I’m not going to find the answer to that in an empty cafeteria.
lines.zh: 我不知道 Ayane 是怎么{i}又{/i}跑到这儿来的，但我知道，答案不会在一个空荡荡的食堂里。

lines.en: As I move through the halls of the school and peer out of the windows, I notice that the world isn’t melting at all.
lines.zh: 穿过学校的走廊、望向窗外时，我注意到世界根本没有在融化。

lines.en: But the last surviving evidences of winter are.
lines.zh: 真正正在融化的，是冬天最后残存的痕迹。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth9
: Oh my god! You’re here! You’re really here! I was so worried! I had no idea what else to do!
lines.zh: : 天哪！你来了！你真的来了！我担心死了！我根本不知道还能怎么办！

lines.en: : You weren’t at your house! You weren’t at the dorms! I even checked the dojo and the cafe and-
lines.zh: : 你不在家！你也不在宿舍！我连道场和咖啡厅都去找了，而且-

lines.en: : I’m here.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿。

lines.en: : It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 没事了。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth10
: Sensei...what in the world is going on? Where did everyone go?
lines.zh: : Sensei……到底发生了什么？大家都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : They’re gone.
lines.zh: : 他们不见了。

lines.en: : What do you mean they’re gone? Where’d they go {i}to{/i}? And why didn’t they take us with them?
lines.zh: : 什么叫不见了？他们去{i}哪儿{/i}了？为什么没带上我们？

lines.en: : Because they couldn’t. And we wouldn’t want to go with them anyway.
lines.zh: : 因为他们带不走。再说我们本来也不想跟他们走。

lines.en: : Maya will explain it better than I can, but you don’t have to worry about everyone else. They’ll come back soon.
lines.zh: : 这件事 Maya 会比我解释得清楚，不过你不用担心其他人。他们很快就回来。

lines.en: : Maya?...Is she here too?
lines.zh: : Maya？……她也在这儿吗？

lines.en: : She’s probably up on the roof watching shooting stars and eating melons or something.
lines.zh: : 她大概在屋顶上看流星、吃甜瓜什么的。

lines.en: : This is actually a situation I’ve found myself in a few times now. And, believe it or not, it’s {i}your{/i} second.
lines.zh: : 这种处境我自己其实已经遇上过几次了。而且，信不信由你，这是{i}你{/i}的第二次。

lines.en: : My second what? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 我的第二次什么？你在说什么？

lines.en: : Your second trip to the end of the world.
lines.zh: : 你第二次来到世界的尽头。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth11
: The...end of the world?...
lines.zh: : 世界的……尽头？……

lines.en: : Or...{i}this{/i} world? It’ll start over once the three of us are together and, before you know it, your beloved summer will have returned.
lines.zh: : 或者……{i}这个{/i}世界？等我们三个聚到一起，一切就会重新开始，在你意识到之前，你心爱的夏天就已经回来了。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth12
: Fuck summer! If it’s the end of the world, all that matters is that I’m with you! I don’t care about anything else!
lines.zh: : 去他妈的夏天！如果真是世界末日，最重要的就是我跟你在一起！别的事我都不在乎！

lines.en: : Well...like I said, the world is going to start over.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我说过了，世界会重新开始。

lines.en: : That’s obviously just a thing you’re saying to me so I don’t have to worry! This is the only world we have!
lines.zh: : 你这明显只是拿来哄我、让我别担心的说辞！我们只有这一个世界！

lines.en: : Ayane, breathe.
lines.zh: : Ayane，呼吸。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth13
: Do you remember the conversation we had earlier tonight? The one where Maya invaded your personal space and you {i}confirmed{/i} that you’re not pregnant?
lines.zh: : 还记得我们今晚早些时候那次对话吗？就是 Maya 入侵你的私人空间、而你{i}确认{/i}了自己没怀孕的那次？

lines.en: : Well, apparently you are.
lines.zh: : 嗯，看来你怀了。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth14
: What? No I’m not. I already told you that. Why don’t you believe me?
lines.zh: : 什么？我没有。我都已经说过了。你为什么不相信我？

lines.en: : How confident are you, though? Because if you’re here-
lines.zh: : 可你有多确定呢？因为如果你在这儿-

lines.en: : I am 100%% confident and I’m not going to tell you any of the details because they are embarrassing and I don’t want you to think I’m disgusting in our last ten minutes on earth.
lines.zh: : 我有 100%% 的把握，而且我不会告诉你任何细节，因为那些细节很丢人，我不想在我们在这世上的最后十分钟里让你觉得我恶心。

lines.en: : Sensei...what is happening? For real...
lines.zh: : Sensei……到底怎么了？说真的……

lines.en: : Well, to reiterate Maya’s summary...
lines.zh: : 好吧，重复一遍 Maya 的总结……

lines.en: : All of us are caught in an infinite time loop and, up until recently, she was the only one aware of it.
lines.zh: : 我们所有人都被困在一个无限的时间循环里，直到不久之前，只有她一个人知道这件事。

lines.en: : Now, we all have to go up to the roof and hug and then she’ll pray or something and we’ll all wake up in a different place at a different time.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们全都得去屋顶上抱在一起，然后她会祈祷什么的，接着我们就会在另一个时间、另一个地方醒来。

lines.en: : If you don’t believe me now, which of course you wouldn’t because it sounds fucking insane, you will when we get up there.
lines.zh: : 如果你现在不信，这当然很正常，因为听起来他妈的疯了，但等我们上去了你就会信的。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth15
: You're...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : You’re...really not kidding...are you?
lines.zh: : 你……真的没在开玩笑……对吧？

lines.en: : This would absolutely not be the time for me to tell jokes. And I’m horrible with them anyway, so you’d know if I was messing around.
lines.zh: : 这种时候我绝对不可能开玩笑。再说我本来就不会讲笑话，所以我要是在逗你，你一眼就能看出来。

lines.en: : Is this...
lines.zh: : 这是……

lines.en: : You asked me something like this at the Christmas party, right?
lines.zh: : 你在圣诞派对上问过我类似的问题，对吧？

lines.en: : And...that thing with the rooftop you asked me months ago...
lines.zh: : 还有……几个月前你问我的那件关于屋顶的事……

lines.en: : This...really is happening.
lines.zh: : 这……真的在发生。

lines.en: : This has {i}been{/i} happening...
lines.zh: : 这{i}一直{/i}都在发生……

lines.en: : But...that doesn’t make sense.
lines.zh: : 可是……这说不通啊。

lines.en: : You’re accepting it a lot easier than I thought you would, all things considered.
lines.zh: : 总的来说，你接受得比我预想的要容易得多。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth16
: It’s just...why would you lie? And why would there be so many instances of you giving me hints about it?
lines.zh: : 只是……你为什么要撒谎？而且为什么会有那么多次你给我暗示？

lines.en: : You’ve wanted me to find out all along, haven’t you?...
lines.zh: : 你一直都想让我自己发现，对吧？……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say I’ve {i}wanted{/i} you to-
lines.zh: : 我不会说我{i}想{/i}让你-

lines.en: : But I definitely don’t mind having someone else around who thinks it’s as weird as I do.
lines.zh: : 但我确实不介意身边多一个跟我一样觉得这事很离谱的人。

lines.en: : I have no idea how Maya is going to feel, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不知道 Maya 会怎么想。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth17
: R-Right! Maya.
lines.zh: : 对-对了！Maya。

lines.en: : You said she’s on the roof, right?
lines.zh: : 你说她在屋顶上，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think that’s where we need to be for the ritual thing to work.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得那个仪式要生效，我们就得去那儿。

lines.en: : And...she’s the one who knows how to teleport us into the future or something?
lines.zh: : 还有……就是她知道怎么把我们传送到未来之类的？

lines.en: : I don’t really think that’s exactly what’s happening, but sure.
lines.zh: : 我觉得实际发生的事跟这个不太一样，不过也差不多吧。

lines.en: : And she’s been doing this for how long exactly?
lines.zh: : 那她这么干多久了？

lines.en: : No clue. A long time- that’s all I know.
lines.zh: : 不知道。很久了-我只知道这个。

lines.en: : And...everyone else is okay? And we’ll get to see them again?
lines.zh: : 还有……其他人都没事吧？我们还能再见到他们吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And I’d hate to interrupt you while you obviously have so many questions, but we should probably head up now and-
lines.zh: : 能。我实在不想打断你，毕竟你显然还有一大堆问题，但我们现在大概该上去-

lines.en: : Wait, no. I only have one more question. I’ll let Maya explain the rest.
lines.zh: : 等等，不。我只有一个问题了。剩下的让 Maya 解释。

lines.en: : I promise.
lines.zh: : 我保证。

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: : What’s your last question, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你最后一个问题是什么，Ayane？

lines.en: : Well...
: Uhh...
: What...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : What happened to your clothes?
lines.zh: : 你的衣服怎么了？

lines.en: scene endofthefourth18
: Well, this has never happened before.
lines.zh: : 啊，这种情况以前从没发生过。

lines.en: : Umm...
: Is...Maya going to be naked too?...
lines.zh: : Maya……也会是裸着的吗？……

lines.en: : Do I...need to...
: I think I have an extra pair of clothes in my office, but you can take your clothes off if you don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 我想我办公室里应该还有一套换洗衣服，不过你要是不介意，也可以把衣服脱了。

lines.en: : It will probably make me showing up with you significantly funnier and less stress-inducing for her at least.
lines.zh: : 至少我带着你出现在她面前会好笑很多，她也不会那么有压力。

lines.en: : No, I...think I’ll keep my clothes on if taking them off is optional...
lines.zh: : 不，我……如果脱不脱都行的话，我想我还是穿着吧……

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : So...are we gonna go to your office now?...
lines.zh: : 那……我们现在要去你办公室了吗？……

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah. My bad.
lines.zh: : 对。我的错。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure to put a note on my door so this doesn’t happen again in the future.
lines.zh: : 我以后一定会在门上贴张纸条，免得再出这种事。

lines.en: : I mean...{i}I{/i} obviously don’t mind. Especially with almost everyone else being gone and stuff. I just always figured you’d have your clothes on for the apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}我{/i}当然不介意。尤其是现在其他人几乎都不在了。我只是没想到世界末日的时候你会不穿衣服。

lines.en: : I’m glad to see that you’ve already imagined this situation in the past.
lines.zh: : 很高兴知道你以前就想象过这种场景。

lines.en: : Doesn’t everybody think about what they’ll do during the apocalypse? Am I really weird for doing that? Probably not, right? Like...since we’re actually experiencing it right now and stuff.
lines.zh: : 大家不都会想自己在世界末日要干嘛吗？我这么想真的很怪吗？应该不怪吧？毕竟……我们现在真的正在经历末日什么的。

lines.en: : Wow, that thing really flops around a lot when it’s not hard, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇，那玩意儿不硬的时候甩得可真厉害，哈？

lines.en: Ayane and I make our way over to my office so I can get a change of clothes and not surprise Maya by revealing my penis to her for the first time in presumably millions of years.
lines.zh: 我和 Ayane 走向我的办公室，好让我换身衣服，不至于在 Maya 面前第一次露出我的 penis——大概几百万年来的第一次。

lines.en: It feels strange to be walking around the school naked but, somehow, it feels even stranger to be walking around in the middle of a reset with someone other than Maya by my side.
lines.zh: 光着身子在学校里走感觉很怪，但不知怎么，在重置之中、身边陪着的人不是 Maya 而是别人，感觉更怪。

lines.en: I don’t normally come-to until I’m on the roof, so...I guess it could have been Ayane’s voice that snapped me out of it?
lines.zh: 我通常都是到屋顶上才醒过来的，所以……我想，也许是 Ayane 的声音把我从那种状态里拽了出来？

lines.en: I have no idea.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: And it looks like it’s time to go back to the drawing board in a multitude of ways considering Maya’s pregnancy theory is now all but confirmed a bust.
lines.zh: 而且看起来在很多方面都得推倒重来了——毕竟 Maya 的怀孕理论现在基本被证实是个死胡同。

lines.en: I throw on a shirt I haven’t worn in quite some time and turn around to face Ayane, who refuses to leave my side for even a second.
lines.zh: 我套上一件很久没穿的衬衫，转身面对 Ayane，她一秒都不肯离开我身边。

lines.en: I don’t blame her.
lines.zh: 我不怪她。

lines.en: Imagine {i}you{/i} woke up one day and everyone you loved was gone?
lines.zh: 想象一下，{i}你{/i}某天醒来，你爱的人全都不见了？

lines.en: Assuming there {i}is{/i} anyone like that.
lines.zh: 假设你身边{i}确实{/i}有这样的人。

lines.en: If there’s not-
lines.zh: 如果没有-

lines.en: Well, maybe you wouldn’t do all that bad here.
lines.zh: 那……也许你在这里也不会过得太糟。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth19
: Um...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 呃……Sensei？……

lines.en: : Yeah?
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : Do we really need to go up there?
lines.zh: : 我们真的非上去不可吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean? Of course we do.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？当然非上去不可。

lines.en: : It’s just...I’ve got this weird feeling in my stomach that’s getting worse the closer we get.
lines.zh: : 只是……我肚子里有种很奇怪的感觉，越靠近就越强烈。

lines.en: : And no, it’s not a baby.
lines.zh: : 而且不是，不是孩子。

lines.en: : We don’t really have a choice, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 可惜我们没得选。

lines.en: : What...happens if we don’t go up, though?
lines.zh: : 可是……如果我们不上去，会怎么样？

lines.en: : Do we just...die?...
lines.zh: : 我们就这么……死掉吗？……

lines.en: : It’s a little more complicated than that, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想，事情比那要复杂一点。

lines.en: : We’ll still be there after the world starts over. It’s just our memories that won’t.
lines.zh: : 世界重新开始之后，我们还是会在这儿。只是我们的记忆不会。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth20
: Our...
lines.zh: : 我们的……

lines.en: : I get it now...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} why you can’t remember anything...
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}你才什么都记不起来……

lines.en: : But, then...
lines.zh: : 可是，那么……

lines.en: : No no no no no....
lines.zh: : 不不不不不……

lines.en: : That can’t be true.
lines.zh: : 这不可能。

lines.en: : Our...entire past with one another...
lines.zh: : 我们……彼此之间那段完整的过去……

lines.en: : Are you saying that’s...
lines.zh: : 你是说那一切……

lines.en: : That’s already gone?...
lines.zh: : 已经没了？……

lines.en: scene endofthefourth21
: I think I’m gonna be sick...
lines.zh: : 我想我要吐了……

lines.en: : We can talk about that later, Ayane. “Our past” can still come back. But if we wait around for too long, there’s a chance it never will.
lines.zh: : 这个我们可以以后再谈，Ayane。「我们的过去」还是会回来的。但要是拖太久，有可能就再也回不来了。

lines.en: : I can’t do it...
lines.zh: : 我做不到……

lines.en: : I can handle the world ending...
lines.zh: : 世界末日我受得了……

lines.en: : I can handle the time loops and the disappearances and...all sorts of things...
lines.zh: : 时间循环、消失、还有……各种事我都受得了……

lines.en: scene endofthefourth22
: But not that...
lines.zh: : 但唯独那个不行……

lines.en: : Not losing the moments and memories that brought me closer to you...
lines.zh: : 唯独不能失去那些让我跟你更靠近的瞬间和记忆……

lines.en: : That’s all I have to hold onto, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 那是我唯一还能抓住的东西，Sensei……

lines.en: : That’s all I-
lines.zh: : 那是我唯一的-

lines.en: scene endofthefourth23
: If you’re going to cry, cry on me.
lines.zh: : 要哭就哭在我身上。

lines.en: : Regardless of whatever happened in the past, we’re together now. And that’s not going to change because of some weird...time loop rules or something.
lines.zh: : 不管过去发生了什么，我们现在在一起。这不会因为什么奇怪的……时间循环规则之类的东西而改变。

lines.en: : I’m so scared, Sensei...I don’t want to go up there anymore...
lines.zh: : 我好害怕，Sensei……我不想再往上走了……

lines.en: : I want to forget about all of this...I can’t do it...
lines.zh: : 我想把这一切都忘掉……我做不到……

lines.en: scene endofthefourth24
: You don’t mean that. I know you.
lines.zh: : 你不是真心的。我了解你。

lines.en: : Being scared is part of life, Ayane. You’ve dealt with a lot worse than the man you’re {i}basically{/i} dating forgetting some stuff from the past.
lines.zh: : 害怕本身就是人生的一部分，Ayane。比那个你{i}差不多{/i}在交往的男人忘掉一些过去的事更糟的事，你都挺过来了。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth25
: ...dating?
: Fuck.
: You’ve never called it that before.
lines.zh: : 你以前从来没这么叫过。

lines.en: : I didn’t call it that now either.
lines.zh: : 我现在也没这么叫。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth26
: Yes you did! I heard it! We’re basically dating!
lines.zh: : 你叫了！我听见了！我们基本上就是在交往！

lines.en: : Ayane, there are more important matters to deal with right now.
lines.zh: : Ayane，现在还有更重要的事要处理。

lines.en: : Fine!
lines.zh: : 好吧！

lines.en: scene endofthefourth27
: Fine...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Even if the world does end when we step onto that roof...
lines.zh: : 就算我们踏上那片屋顶时世界真的会终结……

lines.en: : At least it will end on a good note.
lines.zh: : 至少它会以一个好的方式终结。

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : Say it or I’m not taking another-
lines.zh: : 不说我就不走了-

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: : Now, let’s go...
lines.zh: : 那么，走吧……

lines.en: scene black
Ayane locks her fingers with mine as we take on the last flight of stairs separating us from summer.
lines.zh: Ayane 与我十指相扣，我们一起踏上把我们与夏天隔开的最后一段楼梯。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: Not just separating us from summer...
lines.zh: 不只是把我们与夏天隔开……

lines.en: Separating us from the girl with the worst luck in the world.
lines.zh: 还把我们与那个全世界运气最差的女孩隔开。

lines.en: The one who’s witnessed the end of everything over and over again.
lines.zh: 那个一遍又一遍目睹一切终结的女孩。

lines.en: The one who, even after all this time, persists just so {i}I{/i} can live.
lines.zh: 那个即使过了这么久，依然坚持下去、只为让{i}我{/i}活下去的女孩。

lines.en: I should thank her.
lines.zh: 我该谢谢她。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
I should tell her I appreciate all that she does for me.
lines.zh: 我该告诉她，我很感激她为我做的一切。

lines.en: I should let her say what she wants without giving her any problems.
lines.zh: 我该让她说出她想说的话，别再给她添麻烦。

lines.en: But, most importantly-
lines.zh: 但最重要的-

lines.en: I should admit to her the same thing I’ve already admitted to her two closest friends.
lines.zh: 我该向她坦白那件我已经向她最亲近的两个朋友坦白过的事。

lines.en: I should do that.
lines.zh: 我该这么做。

lines.en: But I can’t.
lines.zh: 但我做不到。

lines.en: scene endofthefourth28
: Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？
